description.html: The Carex® brand provides a full line of Home Health Care Mobility, Bath Safety and Personal Care products that improve quality of life. The brand's line of products ranges from grab bars, transfer benches, shower chairs, wheelchairs, and other physical therapy products to aid in daily living or with various types of illnesses or injuries. Carex takes pride in providing a wide range of home health aides and safety products to improve the quality of life for those in need.

Seventy percent of home accidents occur in the bathroom making it the most dangerous room in the house for seniors. Carex bathroom safety products provide security while blending with your current bathroom decor. Use these products as a collection to create a bathroom with dignity, safety, and peace of mind. Getting in and out of the bath can be hard. Our bathtub assistive devices – such as grab bars and transfer benches – improve bath safety and reduce the risk of injury. These items also serve as handicap accessories and bath aids for elderly people with limited mobility. Bathe with confidence and reclaim one of the most important rooms of your home with Carex bath safety products.

description.html: Carex bathroom Grab bars are available in many sizes ranging from 12"-32" and are finished in white or textured chrome heavy duty stainless steel with drilling required or quick and easy to attach suction cup grab bar models. Our portable grab bars with suction cups easily attach to any smooth surface making grab bar installation quick and effortless regardless of the shower. Use a Carex shower Grab Bar to securely and safely assist with balance in the shower or bathtub.

Stay independent and improve your bath safety with the Carex safety grab bar. The Ultra Grip Grab Bar assists users entering or leaving the bathtub or shower. Its strong suction grips hold tightly to any smooth, flat, and non-porous surface. The bathroom grab bar features a visual indicator that changes from red to green to show when the bar is properly secured into place. No installation is required. Available in 12" or 16". Powerful dual-locking suction cups. The shower safety bar's suction cups make it convenient and easy to install. No need to hire someone or use any power tools to install the bathroom safety bar. Indicates when the bathtub safety bar is properly fastened. A significant drawback for most suction cup shower handles is not knowing when they're fastened. This can lead to injury. Our tub safety bar features indicators that change from red to green to show when it's properly fastened to the wall. Excellent for travel. Because no tools are required, the shower safety handle is perfect for travel. Installing and removing the bathtub only takes a few seconds, making it the perfect portable grab bar. Works on most surfaces. The shower support bar easily attaches to most surfaces including shower tile and fiberglass. For best results from the shower handlebar, install on a smooth surface. Available in 12" or 16". Choose from a more compact 12" bathtub bar or a larger 16" grip bar with more support surface. Smaller bathroom handles are more subtle and fit in more tubs while larger bathtub safety handles offer a larger surface to grab on to. Supports up to 250 lbs. The bathroom safety grab bar offers a reliable and dependable source of support. It can be easily removed and adjusted to a new position based on user needs. Trust in Carex for all of your bathroom safety needs. Our wide selection, guaranteed product warranty, and 35+ year experience make us the trusted brand for anyone looking to improve the safety of their bathroom. Our mission and reason for being are to enable our customers to live healthier, more comfortable, and independent lives. Need help with bathroom safety?
